item.title: All the U.S. Tours From Latin Artists Announced for 2026 (Updating)
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the world of Latin music. I'm your host, and today we're talking about the Latin music tours that took the US by storm in 2025.
[Music transitions to a upbeat Latin rhythm]
Host: Shakira was a touring powerhouse with her Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour, grossing $327.4 million and selling 2.5 million tickets, making it the highest-grossing Latin tour ever by a woman. She even received the inaugural Billboard Global Touring Icon Award for her historic performances.
[Music transitions to a clip of Rauw Alejandro's song]
Host: Rauw Alejandro's Cosa Nuestra Tour was also a huge success, grossing $91.7 million across North America and Europe. This concept tour became the most lucrative of his career, showcasing his unique Broadway-inspired style.
[Music transitions to a more serious tone]
Host: However, 2025 wasn't without its challenges for Latin artists. Regional Mexican artists like Julión Álvarez and Grupo Firme faced visa issues due to the Trump administration's immigration policies, leading to canceled tour dates and festivals.
[Music transitions to a more uplifting tone]
Host: But 2026 is looking promising, with tours announced by Karol G, Omar Courtz, Laura Pausini, and many more. We'll be keeping an eye on these upcoming tours and bringing you updates all year long.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. Join us next time for more on the world of Latin music. [Outro music continues to play until the end]
